fact: Title `chore: generalize an instance to `ContinuousConstSMul`` has the type keyword `chore` but no parenthesised area such as `(Topology/Algebra/Module/FiniteDimension)`.
Description says only 'Cleaning up old branches. I have no specific applications in mind right now', giving no reason the instance's generalisation to `ContinuousConstSMul` is wanted.
Swaps `[ContinuousSMul 𝕜 F]` for `[ContinuousConstSMul 𝕜 F]`; `[TopologicalSpace 𝕜]` stays though the weaker class no longer mentions it, so it may now be unneeded.
The instance takes the section's classes, now `ContinuousConstSMul 𝕜 F` with `IsTopologicalAddGroup F`, `TopologicalSpace 𝕜`, `Field 𝕜`; each is to check against what it uses.
